user.title: Lotto 6/45 Analysis
user.description: Lotto 6/45를 추가합니다. Core 연결은 서비스가 관리하며 API 주소나 토큰을 입력하지 않습니다. 복권과 QR 기록은 이 기기에 보관합니다.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Lotto 6/45 Analysis instance can be configured.

init.title: Lotto 6/45 settings
init.description: Choose which settings to edit. Recommendation settings and personal Four Pillars data are separated so the Configure dialog remains compatible and reliable.

menu_options.recommendations: Draw formulas, AI, and data source

recommendations.title: Draw formulas, AI, and data source
recommendations.description: Select one or more formulas. To enable Personal Four Pillars, first save the birth profile from the previous menu. Detailed explanations are available on the Recommendation Method Guide sensor.

data.ai_task_entity_id: AI Task entity (optional; blank uses the preferred data AI Task)
data.ai_auto_generate: Automatically generate AI recommendation for a new draw
data.allow_official_direct_fallback: Allow limited direct Donghaeng Lottery fallback

data_description.selected_methods: Multiple formulas can be selected. Personal Four Pillars can only be enabled after the personal profile has been saved. None of these formulas changes the mathematical winning probability. The selected-formula median consensus requires at least two other local formulas and excludes AI. Sensors for formulas removed from the selection are deleted from the entity registry after reload.
data_description.enable_ai_recommendation: AI is independent from local formulas. Manual Refresh / Regenerate does not regenerate the AI recommendation.
data_description.ai_auto_generate: Only generates AI automatically when a new official draw is detected. Manual local regeneration suppresses AI generation.
data_description.allow_official_direct_fallback: Only used when the shared mirror is unavailable. It can fetch at most a tiny recent gap, uses sequential rate-limited requests, and never crawls the full history. Keep this disabled unless needed.
data_description.advanced_methods: Alternative implementations/presets of existing families, not better winning strategies. Existing selections are preserved.

saju.title: Personal Four Pillars profile
saju.description: Save personal birth information before using the Four Pillars recommendation. Birth place is selected from the 17 first-level South Korean regions and Asia/Seoul is applied automatically. Raw birth data remains local to Home Assistant.

data.saju_remote_consent: 사주 계산에 필요한 출생정보를 연결한 Core API로 전송하는 데 동의 (서버 원문 비저장)

data_description.saju_birth_time: Use the recorded local birth time. Explicit unknown omits the hour pillar; boundary cases still require a known time.
data_description.saju_birth_place: Choose one of the 17 South Korean first-level regions. No geocoding or external dataset is requested. A legacy overseas value already saved by an older release remains selectable only as that saved value.
data_description.saju_lunar_leap_month: Used only for lunar-calendar birth dates.
data_description.saju_true_solar_time: When enabled, the hour pillar time is corrected using timezone meridian, longitude and equation of time.
data_description.saju_longitude: Only needed when true solar time correction is enabled.
data_description.saju_lunar_standard: Korean and Chinese lunar dates can differ. Existing lunar profiles retain Chinese conversion until you select a different standard.

purchases.title: Choose the draw on your ticket
purchases.description: Enter the draw number printed on your ticket, then enter up to five games A–E. Saved draws: {saved_rounds}. Other rounds are retained.

purchase_games.title: Purchased tickets A–E
purchase_games.description: Selected draw: {round}. Enter six distinct numbers 1–45 per line, separated by commas/spaces, or twelve zero-padded digits (010203040506). Leave unused games blank. Saving replaces A–E for this round only. This does not verify ownership or payment.

error.select_at_least_one: Select at least one draw formula.
error.saju_profile_required: Save the Personal Four Pillars profile from the previous menu before enabling this draw formula.
error.invalid_saju_profile: Check birth date, time, lunar standard/leap month, timezone and longitude. Solar-term or DST boundary ambiguity requires a known time.
error.options_error: An error occurred while processing the options. Check the entered values and try again.
error.consensus_sources_required: 합의 추천에는 합의·AI를 제외한 다른 로컬 공식이 2개 이상 필요합니다.
error.invalid_purchase_numbers: Enter six distinct integers 1–45 separated by commas/spaces, or twelve zero-padded digits.
error.purchase_games_required: Enter at least one game, or select delete explicitly.
error.purchase_storage_unavailable: Could not save. Existing tickets are preserved.
error.purchase_game_limit: Enter at most five games (A–E) per draw.
error.select_korean_birthplace: Choose one of the 17 South Korean regions.
error.invalid_generation_rules: 조건이 서로 충돌하거나 입력 범위가 올바르지 않습니다. 위 안내를 확인하세요.
error.service_connection_failed: 서버 주소·토큰·인증서 또는 입력 조건을 확인하세요. 기존 기록은 유지됩니다.

abort.purchase_integration_not_ready: Wait for the integration to finish setup.
abort.purchase_storage_unavailable: Check local ticket storage. Existing records have not been overwritten.
